name: Entity Segment: Group
description: Exposes segments as Group content, so a segment can be related to a group via the Group module.
project_description: An integration target submodule that bridges the Entity Segment engine to the contrib Group module. It ships a derived group relation (group_segment) — one per segment type — so a group type can accept Contact, User, or any admin-created segment type. Access is additive and orthogonal: group roles ADD CRUD to a group's global segments on top of the base engine's owner/scope/admin access, never revoking it (an access decorator downgrades Group's default forbidden to neutral). Only global segments can be group content, enforced end to end. drupal/group (^3.3 || ^4) is a dependency of this submodule only.
